verdict_reason: The Latin-name mapping is correct and tested, but the comment describes the journey and backend and the pa parameter is unnamed.

todos.issue: The comment at lines 4-6 describes the journey ('keeps phone and email inside the address block') and the backend ('keeps them on the party, and drops any field it does not know') rather than the lines below. House rule: a comment never describes other modules or the backend.
todos.fix: Must: no comment in the file describes the journey or the backend; the function's name says what it builds. One way: delete the comment and rename permanentAddressFrom to partyFromPermanentAddress (or similar) so the target shape is in the name.

todos.issue: The parameter pa (line 7) is an abbreviation that does not say what it holds, a journey permanent address; the diff renamed units/unit to identifierUnits/firstUnit in the same file but left this one.
todos.fix: Must: the parameter is named for what it holds. One way: rename pa to permanentAddress.
